bio: Hi, I'm Tyler, the person behind LazyNinja.

I build various projects that I find interesting or important to not just me but anyone. I have been involved in multiple projects and social groups in my time away from the computer. I have competed in Sparatahack 11 and my team won the best beginner hack and the Auto Owners Insurance hack.

timeline.title: Building LazyNinja LLC
timeline.text: Rebuilding the LazyNinja "brand" into more of just who I am as a developer than a website business. Although LazyNinja is still able to build your business a website. Its not the sole thing that LazyNInja does now.
